cases.operation: One valid tenant principal with deliberately invalid disposable password; valid TLS/hostname and allowed source unchanged. No produce, consume, group join or commit.
cases.expected_failure_layer: Typed SCRAM authentication failure after verified TLS, before authenticated Kafka operation. Local missing/invalid input is not broker authentication evidence.
cases.positive_control: Same principal, endpoint, SDK and peer using approved valid credential completes read-only own-topic metadata immediately around the negative.
cases.required_evidence: Reviewed code/config hashes; safe error enum/stage; TLS success; bounded control/negative timestamps; no secret, password hash or raw SDK logs.
cases.capability_needed: Additive narrow read-only authentication probe; frozen R2 engine has no approved credential-override scenario. Do not corrupt a mounted active Secret.
cases.required_later_live_authorization: Exact target, principal reference, disposable invalid input, image/config, allowed source, bounds, executor/window and credential-delivery procedure.
cases.claim_limit: Does not qualify rotation, retired credentials or existing-session revocation; do not brute force or retry automatically.

Positive control absent or wrong-layer failure
Unclassified/timeout-only outcome without intended-layer corroboration

common_rules: Planning data only; no Kubernetes resource, runnable client, arming file or executable invocation is supplied.
Do not relax native/frozen allowlists, alter current source/image pins, change trust/RBAC/ACL/network policies or mount invalid inputs into any existing workload.

Later selected finite packet must bind exact operation/source/image/identity/address/requests/deadline/resources/stop/termination/custody and user authorization. Authorization for one case does not authorize all rows.
Same-path positive controls must be fresh for that operation; reuse successful R2 denials as historical acceptance, not as a fresh negative-control sandwich.

No raw errors, log streams, passwords/password hashes, bearer tokens, private keys, Secret contents, payloads or configuration dumps in evidence; use reviewed enums/stages and nonsecret identity references.
A failure without intended-layer evidence is INCONCLUSIVE. Unexpected forbidden success stops the packet, retains sanitized evidence and grants no repair authority.
No automatic cleanup/deletion/retry; stop evidence retained separately by physical attempt, never overwrite historical R2 export.
All four existing client Jobs remain suspended and unchanged; any later live probe needs its own separately authorized identity and execution artifact.
not_selected: New/external listener or dedicated cluster qualification
later_user_decisions: Only when selecting live work: exact bounded operation/window/executor and any necessary disposable source placement/credential-reference authority.
Only for a hostile-tenant claim: select tenant namespace/service-account, workload-creation/admission and allowed Secret policy. No need to settle this to finish the offline package.
